About Elogic Commerce - Ecommerce Development Company for Complex B2B & B2B2C
Elogic Commerce is an ecommerce development company specializing exclusively in ecommerce solutions across Adobe Commerce (Magento), Shopify Plus, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, and commercetools. Founded in 2009, we deliver complex B2B and integration-heavy commerce projects - platform development, migrations, and integrations with ERP, PIM, and CRM systems. We are certified and partner-aligned across key platforms, supporting mid-market and enterprise clients in the US and Europe through dedicated teams and long-term support models.
Elogic Commerce is an Award-Winning, Certified Ecommerce Development Company
